ctx.x: Well now, getting back to Armstrong, did you -- how well did you know him?
Know him? I knew Louis Armstrong pretty well, very well. Big Sid Catlett -- one of the greatest --
What kind of a person did you find Armstrong to be?

items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. Sid was a friend of most people, drummers and whatnot. Sid -- people wanted to be friends of his, period. Yes, we were good friends. Big Sid Catlett.

ctx.x: Did you play with him much?
No, I didn't. Big Sid Catlett was his drummer. I didn't play too much with Louis. Maybe I made a record or something or a date with him or something like that, but not too much. No, I didn't.

Well, you know, there seems to be -- a lot of people who knew him say that he was very -- the image that people have of him on the bandstand as being an Uncle Tom or something, that he wasn't like that off the bandstand at all.
